name: Fridge Mind
tagline: A camera in the fridge tracks what you have and when it will spoil, to cut household food waste.

awards: Deloitte: Best Use of AI for Green

problem: Food goes bad before anyone remembers it; the team cites Canadian waste figures.
solution: A Raspberry Pi camera with object detection inventories the fridge and a mobile app tracks freshness and reminds you.
demo_moment: Team-described: open the fridge and see the app update the inventory.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Deloitte: Best Use of AI for Green” among 131 submissions.
Grounded in a common household annoyance.

lessons: Sustainability prizes favour a measurable household behaviour change.
